hooks.command: powershell -Command "$input = $null; try { $input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {}; if ($input -and $input.command -match 'git push') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- Pre-Push Reminder ---'; Write-Host 'Before pushing, confirm:'; Write-Host '  1. Build succeeds locally (npm run build)'; Write-Host '  2. No broken local image paths (/wp-content/uploads/...)'; Write-Host '  3. All new pages have correct title + meta description'; Write-Host '  4. Trailing slashes consistent on all internal links'; Write-Host '  5. No http:// links (must be https://)'; Write-Host '--------------------------'; Write-Host '' }"

powershell -Command "$input = $null; try { $input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {}; $file = if ($input) { if ($input.file_path) { $input.file_path } elseif ($input.path) { $input.path } else { '' } } else { '' }; if ($file -match '\.astro$') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- SEO Pre-check (before save) ---'; Write-Host ' Verify before writing:'; Write-Host ' 1. Page is under 60 characters'; Write-Host ' 2. All <img> tags have descriptive alt text'; Write-Host ' 3. No hardcoded http:// URLs (use https:// or local paths)'; Write-Host ' 4. No remote telecommnet.com image URLs (use /wp-content/uploads/...)'; Write-Host ' 5. Only one <h1> per page'; Write-Host '-----------------------------------'; Write-Host '' }"

powershell -Command "$input = $null; try { $input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {}; $file = if ($input) { if ($input.file_path) { $input.file_path } elseif ($input.path) { $input.path } else { '' } } else { '' }; if ($file -match '\.astro$') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- Astro File Saved: Post-Edit Checks ---'; $content = if (Test-Path $file) { Get-Content $file -Raw } else { '' }; $issues = @(); if ($content -match 'http://[^{]') { $issues += 'WARN: http:// link found — should be https://' }; if ($content -match 'href="\./') { $issues += 'WARN: Relative href starting with ./ — use absolute /path/ instead' }; if ($content -match 'src="https?://telecommnet\.com/wp-content') { $issues += 'ERROR: Remote image URL pointing to telecommnet.com — must use local /wp-content/uploads/ path' }; if ($content -match '<h1' -and ($content -split '<h1').Count -gt 2) { $issues += 'WARN: Multiple <h1> tags detected — only one H1 per page' }; if ($content -notmatch '<title>|title=') { $issues += 'WARN: No page title detected — ensure BaseLayout title= is set' }; if ($issues.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '  All basic checks passed.' } else { $issues | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" } }; Write-Host '  Next steps: verify schema renders, check mobile layout, test internal links.'; Write-Host '-------------------------------------------'; Write-Host '' } elseif ($file -match 'src[/\\]lib[/\\].*\.ts$') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- Schema/TS File Saved ---'; Write-Host '  Reminder: verify JSON-LD renders correctly in the browser.'; Write-Host '  Run: npm run check:schema (once build is complete)'; Write-Host '  Test at: https://search.google.com/test/rich-results'; Write-Host '  Also validate at: https://validator.schema.org/'; Write-Host '----------------------------'; Write-Host '' } elseif ($file -match 'public[/\\]_headers$') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- _headers File Saved ---'; $content = if (Test-Path $file) { Get-Content $file -Raw } else { '' }; $lines = $content -split "`n"; $issues = @(); $inBlock = $false; foreach ($line in $lines) { $trimmed = $line.TrimEnd(); if ($trimmed -match '^/') { $inBlock = $true } elseif ($trimmed -eq '') { $inBlock = $false } elseif ($inBlock -and $trimmed -notmatch '^\s+\S+:\s+\S+') { $issues += "WARN: Malformed header line: '$trimmed'" } }; if ($issues.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '  _headers syntax looks valid.' } else { $issues | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" } }; Write-Host '  Verify live with: npx wrangler pages dev public --port 3001'; Write-Host '---------------------------'; Write-Host '' } elseif ($file -match 'public[/\\]_redirects$') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- _redirects File Saved ---'; $content = if (Test-Path $file) { Get-Content $file -Raw } else { '' }; $lines = $content -split "`n"; $issues = @(); $lineNum = 0; foreach ($line in $lines) { $lineNum++; $trimmed = $line.TrimEnd(); if ($trimmed -eq '' -or $trimmed -match '^#') { continue }; $parts = $trimmed -split '\s+'; if ($parts.Count -lt 2) { $issues += "Line $lineNum`: Missing destination — '$trimmed'" } elseif ($parts.Count -ge 3 -and $parts[2] -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { $issues += "Line $lineNum`: Status code '$(${parts}[2])' is not numeric" } }; if ($issues.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '  _redirects syntax looks valid.' } else { $issues | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" } }; Write-Host '  Verify live with: npx wrangler pages dev public --port 3001'; Write-Host '-----------------------------'; Write-Host '' } elseif ($file -match 'public[/\\]llms(-full)?\.txt$') { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- llms.txt Updated ---'; Write-Host '  Reminder: after deploy, verify the file is accessible at:'; Write-Host '  https://telecommnet.com/llms.txt'; if ($file -match 'llms-full\.txt$') { Write-Host '  https://telecommnet.com/llms-full.txt' }; Write-Host '  Check that AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.) are not blocked in robots.txt'; Write-Host '------------------------'; Write-Host '' }"
